examples.sentence: (除非)你答应我的条件，我才告诉你。
examples.romanization: ( chúfēi) nǐ dāying wǒ de tiáojiàn， wǒ cái gàosu nǐ。
examples.translation: (Unless) you promise me, I won’t tell you.

examples.sentence: 这种机器，除非李阳，没人修得好。
examples.romanization: zhèzhǒng jīqì， chúfēi lǐ yáng， méi rén xiū dé hǎo。
examples.translation: This kind of machine, except Li Yang, no one can fix.

title: V1 得 (O) 直 V2 (V1 O so much that O V2)
shortExplanation: V1 O so much that O V2
longExplanation: V1 O so much that O V2. Pinyin: V1 dé (O) zhí V2

examples.sentence: 父亲听说儿子卖了房子，气得(他)直发抖。
examples.romanization: fùqīn tīngshuō érzi mài le fángzi， qì dé( tā) zhí fādǒu。
examples.translation: The father heard that his son had sold the house. He was so angry that he kept on shivering.

examples.sentence: 直到今天，我也不明白他当时为什么发那么大脾气。
examples.romanization: zhídào jīntiān， wǒ yě bù míngbai tā dāngshí wèishénme fā nàme dà píqi。
examples.translation: Until today, I don’t understand why he had such a bad temper at the time.

examples.sentence: 不管你们谁去，反正我不会去。
examples.romanization: bùguǎn nǐmen shéi qù， fǎnzhèng wǒ bùhuì qù。
examples.translation: I don’t care if any of you go. I won’t go anyway.

title: 甲乙丙丁 (A, B, C, D (series))
longExplanation: A, B, C, D (series). Pinyin: jiǎyǐ bǐng dīng

examples.sentence: 如果乙方同意，甲方可以可以提前把产品交给乙方。
examples.romanization: rúguǒ yǐfāng tóngyì， jiǎfāng kěyǐ kěyǐ tíqián bǎ chǎnpǐn jiāogěi yǐfāng。
examples.translation: If Party B agrees, Party A may give the product to Party B in advance.

examples.sentence: 汗水顺着他的脸往下流。
examples.romanization: hànshuǐ shùnzhe tā de liǎn wǎng xiàliú。
examples.translation: The sweat flowed down (along) his face.

examples.sentence: 鸟类能觉察得出地球自北向南磁极的磁力线。
examples.romanization: niǎolèi néng juéchá déchū dìqiú zì běi xiàngnán cíjí de cílìxiàn。
examples.translation: Birds can perceive the magnetic field lines from the earth’s north magnetic pole to the south magnetic pole.

title: 把 O (给) V 了 (have V’ed the O)
longExplanation: have V’ed the O. Pinyin: bǎ O ( gěi) V le

examples.romanization: wǒ bǎ zhè shì( gěi) wàng le。

examples.sentence: 我的手机给小偷偷走了。
examples.romanization: wǒ de shǒujī gěi xiǎo tōutōu zǒu le。
examples.translation: My mobile phone was stolen by the thief.

examples.sentence: 天气这么好，何不出去玩儿玩儿呢？
examples.romanization: tiānqì zhème hǎo， hébù chūqù wánr wánr ne？
examples.translation: The weather is so good, why not go out and play?
